intel.title: [CISA KEV] Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router - Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-103406
廠商: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE)
產品: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
漏洞名稱: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
說明: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-28
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 釋出 HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor 與 Session Smart Router 之 OS 命令注入漏洞（CVE-2026-103406）情資。遠端攻擊者可利用特製的 salt minion ID 執行任意 root 權限命令。經比對公司資產清冊，目前並未部署此硬體設備或相關系統。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Vates Xen Orchestra - Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-133469
廠商: Vates
產品: Xen Orchestra
漏洞名稱: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
說明: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-28
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://docs.vates.tech/security-advisories/advisories/2026/vates-sa-2026-062/ ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-133469

analysis.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra 存在身分驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-133469），未授權攻擊者可透過構造含有空 JSON 物件的身份驗證權牌取得管理員權限。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV）。經比對公司資產清冊，內部並未部署或使用 Xen Orchestra 相關系統。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
